description: This file defines API routes for managing user progress data, including exercise logs and body metrics, with role-based access control. It uses FastAPI for routing and SQLAlchemy for database interactions.

methods.name: _resolve_target_user_id
methods.description: Helper function to determine the target user ID based on current user's role and provided target_user_id, implementing role-based access control.

methods.name: create_exercise_log_endpoint
methods.description: API endpoint to create an exercise log for the current or specified user, with role-based restrictions.

methods.name: list_exercise_logs_endpoint
methods.description: API endpoint to list exercise logs for the current or specified user, with role-based restrictions and filtering options.

methods.name: create_body_metrics_endpoint
methods.description: API endpoint to create body metrics for the current or specified user, with role-based restrictions.

methods.name: list_body_metrics_endpoint
methods.description: API endpoint to list body metrics for the current or specified user, with role-based restrictions and filtering options.
